info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Delete Meetings Meetings Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Cancel Meetings API allows users to efficiently manage their scheduling by canceling existing meetings. This endpoint primarily targets event organizers and administrators who need to update meeting plans due to changes in availability or scheduling conflicts. By utilizing this API, users can ensure their calendars remain accurate and reflect current arrangements. This endpoint provides the functionality required to maintain an organized and productive meeting environment.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel a scheduled meeting by providing the necessary meeting identifier. Ensure that the meeting is eligible for cancellation based on your organization's guidelines.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary information to cancel a scheduled meeting. Ensure that the details match the meeting that you intend to cancel.

200.description: The meeting has been successfully canceled.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the body of the request for cancelling a meeting operation.
